issues.description: The script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to send data to discord.com (likely via webhook) and nominatim.openstreetmap.org. This may include map coordinates, user actions, or other game-related data.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only non-sensitive, user-approved data is sent. Inform users clearly about what is transmitted.

issues.description: The script hooks into WebSocket.prototype.send and WebSocket.prototype.addEventListener to intercept and possibly modify game data. While it does not appear to exfiltrate user credentials, it does manipulate game communication.
issues.recommendation: Do not intercept or modify WebSocket traffic unless strictly necessary and with user consent.

issues.description: The script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest permission, which is high-privilege and can be abused for data exfiltration.
issues.recommendation: Limit permissions to only those required. Remove GM_xmlhttpRequest if not strictly necessary.

issues.description: The script requests @connect to discord.com and nominatim.openstreetmap.org, which are third-party services. Data sent to these endpoints may be outside user control.
issues.recommendation: Ensure all third-party endpoints are trusted and data sent is minimal and anonymized.

details: Intercepts game data via WebSocket, including player guesses and possibly usernames.
May send map coordinates and game actions to Discord webhooks.

script_name: CheatGuessr Universal | GeoGuessr | OpenGuessr | WorldGuessr | FreeGuessr | GeoDuels
summary: This script transmits game data (including map coordinates and possibly user actions) to third-party services such as Discord and OpenStreetMap. It hooks into WebSocket communication, which may impact privacy and game integrity. No code obfuscation or DOM XSS risks were detected. The script requests high-privilege permissions and connects to external endpoints, introducing supply chain and data exfiltration risks. User consent and transparency are critical.
